<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at v0.69.0-beta -->

## What's Changed
### New Features
* feature(cloud-api): public price catalog endpoint for the marketing site by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/416
* feature(cloud-api): vault password auth + E2E key hierarchy endpoints (#394) by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/421
* feature(kmp/tv): settings-sync engine + TV wiring + plans (#394) by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/426
* feature(tv): slow-motion speed control in clip playback by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/427
* feature(tv): enable 2x2 Quad View in standalone mode by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/431
* feature(engine): RAM segment ring — zero flash wear for the standalone buffer by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/436
* feature(cloud-api): cloud-host vault + TV device-approval pages at /pages (#400) by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/430
### Bug Fixes
* fix(dns): re-register the custom subdomain on startup, not just the installation-id record by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/383
* fix(certs): reissue the ACME wildcard when DOMAINS change, not only near expiry by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/384
* fix(tv): salvage PR #358 — real store price on onboarding Pro card + trial copy by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/408
* fix(tv): onboarding Pro card purchases the trial directly; currency-matched cards; price prefetch by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/409
* fix(auth): registering an existing email says "welcome back"; already-entitled skips the store by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/410
* fix(billing): restore on "already purchased" instead of claiming entitlement by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/411
* fix(tier): 10-min tier re-validation loop while the app runs (standalone parity) by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/413
* fix(tv): tier pill in the Watch top bar updates live after purchase/plan change by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/414
* fix(tv): Settings tier updates live while the screen is open by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/415
* fix(billing): resolve account_key to email before sending dunning email (#385) by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/420
* fix(tv): per-cell playback recovery in native multi-view (#432) by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/437
### Performance
* perf(billing): warm RevenueCat login+offerings at auth so prices render instantly by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/412
### Other Changes
* refactor(tiers): rename the enterprise tier display label to "Max" by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/428
* chore(android): build FFmpeg + ffprobe for arm64-v8a (#398) by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/434


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/compare/tv-v0.1.18...v0.69.0-beta

## What's Changed
### New Features
* feature: Kotlin Multiplatform migration — shared :core (Ktor) + Compose Multiplatform phone/iOS apps by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/359
* feature: mobile live/delayed player (Watch tab) by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/361
* feature(mobile): fetch billing/entitlement on auth so tier helpers and account UI reflect the real tier by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/362
* feat(mobile): clip Download and Share actions (shared-ui seam, all platforms) by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/363
* feature: web→Kotlin design-asset codegen (icons, tokens, glyph, delays) by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/364
* chore(android): CI coverage for KMP modules + :mobile R8/signing hardening by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/365
* feat(tv): TV theme colors generated from webapp source by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/366
* feature(mobile): phone-as-camera v1 — :capture RTSP server, hardware H.264, Settings entry by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/370
* feature(mobile): in-app purchases via RevenueCat (Google Play) — shared upgrade sheet + Play-policy manage-on-web fallback by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/371
* feature(mobile): player polish — slow-mo tier gating, per-camera delay memory, landscape fixes by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/373
* feature(capture): phone-as-camera v2 — LAN advertising + one-click pairing in TV standalone by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/375
* feature(tv): onboarding camera step — skip option + phone-camera pairing; drop build-a-view step by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/378
* feature(domain): hard-cut migration from echolab-app.com to echolab.app by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/382
### Bug Fixes
* fix(tv): onboarding camera preview stuck on "Reconnecting" by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/354
* fix(ci): give the dev cloud-api deploy its own app-scoped Fly token by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/357
* fix(mobile): system Back pops in-app navigation instead of exiting (#368) by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/369
* fix(mobile): https→http scheme fallback for discovered installs by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/372
* fix(mobile): delay accuracy — shared drift compensation (measured 20s → 10.7s at a 10s selection) by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/374
* fix(tv): QR sign-in from onboarding bounced back to flow start by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/377
* fix(tv): resume onboarding after QR sign-in instead of restarting at Welcome by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/379
* fix(tv): wire onboarding Pro trial to the real store purchase flow by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/380
* fix(auth): QR sign-in never stored the account user id — upgrade stayed locked by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/381
### Other Changes
* chore(ci): auto-deploy dev cloud-api alongside prod on push to main by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/355
* chore(tv): update launcher banner + icon to final wordmark branding by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/356
* feature(mobile): settings tabs at webapp parity — Presets, Clips, System storage bar by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/367
* chore(mobile): bump to 0.1.3 (4) by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/376


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/compare/v0.67.1-beta...v0.68.0-beta

## What's Changed
